summary: In this video, the creator conducts a summon session on the Option Summons II banner after selecting the Thunderbolt and Toxin schools. He experiences extraordinary luck, pulling numerous Legendary heroes including Tariz, Stanguem, Alaura, Irmoush, Durango, Vicana, Perkunte, Jathalea, and Nissa within 300 pulls. At the 300-pull selector milestone, he evaluates whether to choose Lothair or Sleight to upgrade his Toxin setup. He plans to utilize the Temporal Corridor Exchange Shop to reach Inspiration 3 on Lothair, gaining 60 Enlightenment to boost his Continental Challenge boss damage against Talethia.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.note: Valuable Thunderbolt damage dealer needed to fight the Talethia boss in Continental Challenge.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Reaching Inspiration 3 grants +60 Enlightenment, significantly increasing damage output against endgame bosses.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Key Toxin hero whose inspirations can also be built via the Temporal Corridor shop alongside Lothair.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Gains passive damage bonuses for Lightning Bolt when inspired.

heroes.name: Irmoush
heroes.note: Ignores 25 percent enemy resistance when inspired to boost overall damage.

tips: Save Dust-Sealed Tomes to purchase high-value duplicate Legendary heroes in the Temporal Corridor Exchange Shop for Inspiration upgrades.
Prioritize getting key Toxin damage dealers like Lothair to Inspiration 3 for the +60 Enlightenment stat boost in boss content.
